_source: IICE Incubation Policy and legacy site facilities/apply pages
name: Physical incubation
forWhom: Deep-tech, bioscience, materials, and hardware startups requiring dedicated lab benches, office cubicles, and CIF access at IISER Bhopal.
includes: Dedicated office cubicles and co-working desks within the 10,000 sq ft IICE facility (2nd Floor, Main Building, IISER Bhopal)
Access to wet/dry research laboratories and IISER Bhopal's Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) at incubatee tariff rates
Registered office address on campus for MCA incorporation, GST, and DPIIT Startup India recognition
Dedicated IISER Bhopal faculty mentor and Technical Evaluation Committee progress reviews
Eligibility for DST NIDHI-TBI Seed Support and BIRAC-EDGE grant facilitation
terms: As per IISER Bhopal & DST NIDHI-TBI Incubation Agreement norms (nominal license fee and standard incubator equity/revenue-share policy).
